name: Suez Canal Obstruction
description: A large container vessel has run aground in the Suez Canal, blocking all northbound and southbound traffic. Salvage operations are underway but the canal is expected to remain closed for 2-4 weeks.

emergencyActions: Reroute all Europe-to-Middle East shipments via Cape of Good Hope
Pre-position critical spares at Jebel Ali free zone warehouse
Accelerate procurement of long-lead items with Asian suppliers unaffected by Suez
Coordinate with freight forwarders for rail alternatives via Turkey corridor
